atlas_description: Detects and curates breakpoints across many catfish species (Cgar / Cmac + 18 outgroup genomes). Two independent method families — sequence (wfmash BP_ATLAS) and gene-order (BUSCO single-copy orthologs). Cross-method validated headlines + reciprocity tiers. Hands coordinates (never claims) to inversion / evolution / popstats atlases via the cross_reference_handoffs declared in atlas-core's cohorts.registry.json. See docs/HANDOFF_COMPLETE.md for the full method document.

pages.label: BP catalogue
pages.tooltip: Tiered headline breakpoint table — Tier 1 cross-method validated (gene_order AND wfmash sequence agree ≤ tolerance) vs Tier 2 recurrent (single method, ≥ 3 species). Reads breakpoint_clusters_v1 + pairwise_summary_v1 + tolerance_sweep_v1.

pages.label: BP reciprocity
pages.tooltip: Per-zone both-anchor reciprocity from BP3c — zones supported from Cgar AND Cmac anchors. Confidence tier (high/med/low) + backbone_support flag from Pass B.

pages.label: BP arc view
pages.tooltip: BP5 figure-style PAF arc visualisation. Reads atlas_paf_arcs.json + atlas_data.json.
